description:
The ultralight 24" woom OFF 5 features a carbon fork, 9-speed gearing, and hydraulic disc brakes engineered for flowing trails and off-road adventures for riders aged 7 and up. Featuring our latest component updates and refined engineering for young mountain bikers aged 7 and up.
Looking for our previous version? Use the selector below to toggle between the Newest Model and our 2023 Model.

groupset.description: MicroSHIFT Advent 9-Speed with fine-tuned gear ratios

components.description: Cr-Mo axle and sealed industrial-grade ball bearings
Hydraulic disc brakes Tektro HD-J3120; Rotor diameter front/back: 160/160 mm; Ergonomic short-reach brake levers designed for children's hands
Cassette with 11–38 teeth
Active Motion Clutch Eliminates chain slap and prevents chain drops for whisper-quiet rides without interruption.
Narrow-wide chainring with 28 teeth
Lightweight forged aluminum 130 mm cranks with narrow Q-factor
Short cage rear derailleurs for maximum ground clearance:
Lightweight woom carbon fork; Multidirectional carbon fibers for high torsional stiffness; 1 ⅛ – 1″ tapered steerer tube; 100 x 15 mm thru axles; Post mount for disc brake
Child-friendly thanks to small diameter; Single-clamp grip to prevent twisting; Safety zone: extra rubber on palm-facing portion of grip for added comfort; 100% silicone for maximum grip
Wide, ergonomically adapted and lightweight aluminum bars for more control; Tapered end to fit child’s hand; Sandblasted and silver anodized; Width: 585 mm; Rise: 20 mm
Fully integrated 1 – 1 ⅛" headset; Sealed industrial bearings
4 mm hex key for stem and seatpost clamp; 8 mm hex key for front wheel and pedals
Platform pedals made from fiber-reinforced nylon with metal pins for added grip
Ergonomically designed to fit children's anatomy; Streamlined mountain-bike specific saddle design; Side protection to lean against walls
27.2 x 250 mm; Anodized aluminum seatpost with insertion marks that indicate the minimum insertion depth; Quick-release seatpost clamp
Quick-release seatpost clamp for easy adjustments; Made from aluminum
Precise, Kid-Centric Shifting; MS Advent Trigger SL-M6195-R with short-reach rubber pad levers. Lower shifting force to quickly and effortlessly change gears.
Forged aluminum; CNC-machined; Handlebars attached via two clamps; Rise/drop: +/-15° with flip-flop design to adjust handlebar height; Length: 50 mm

24 x 2.35” Schwalbe Rocket Ron Performance ADDIX GREEN - combines speed and cornering control at the highest possible level. Cleverly designed tread balanced for low rolling resistance whilst remaining grippy; Presta valves

Lightweight aluminum rims from Alexrims; Size: 24″; Aluminum hubs with sealed industrial bearings; Thru-axles for maximum torsional strength (100 × 15 mm front / 135 × 12 mm rear); 20 spokes, double-crossed spoking; Aluminum nipples
